bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. All bags are searched, and bags that are not clear get an additional search.
bagPolicy.note: Coat check and merch check are available year round, first come, first served. Diabetic guests may bring a small amount of unopened snacks.

parking.note: The Fillmore Detroit has partnered with ParkWhiz for easy and reliable parking options. Accessible parking is available on Elizabeth Street and Columbia Street, with paved terrain and street crossings to the venue.

rideshare.note: Use the main entrance on Woodward Avenue for passenger drop-off.

concessions.note: The Fillmore Detroit offers a Fast Lane and State Bar Pass for quick entry and access to drinks at The State Bar, which is attached to the venue. There are no specific details about food options available on the venue's website.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices. The accessible restroom is located on the main level off to the left of the main floor.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry isn't allowed. Once you enter, you can't leave and come back.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is open Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 12 to 6 PM, and two hours before door time on show days. If you have trouble with your mobile ticket, visit the box office on event day with your ID.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Use the main entrance on Woodward Avenue, which is fully accessible. Guest services staff can help you to the accessible seating area.
